decisions.reason: The organic superfood drink is far from the firm's waste-to-energy core, and the lack of any website presence after 2019 suggests results below aspiration; with little slack in a small startup, problemistic search points to moving its resources back to the core plant business.

The modular plant extensions were only ever mentioned, never given their own page, which signals weak traction, and a resource-constrained firm cannot carry an add-on whose results are this uncertain.

WASTX Oil was the flagship with its own page and a press launch, and as the core of the firm's decentralised waste-to-energy identity it is the product management would protect while searching for solutions elsewhere.

Plastic-to-fuel gained its own page in 2019, but the missing website activity in 2020–2021 points to a shortfall against aspirations, and limited slack makes concentrating on the oil flagship more likely than funding a second capital-intensive plant line.
